reason: Documentation and test-gate only — no runtime behaviour changes. `config.example.toml` is a template that the running deployment does not read (the deployment reads the tracked `config.toml`, which is untouched), and the only code edit is a comment in `nora/agent/factory.py`. Implements A8 and a scoped-down A6 from the 2026-08-20 prompt-architecture audit: syncs the template to the deployment for the values that are not site-specific (llm.model opencode-zen -> ollamacloud, reasoning_effort low -> high, timeout_seconds 30 -> 120, evals.judge_model pro -> flash), adds the fourteen keys and two whole sections ([shortener], [compute]) the deployment sets but the template never declared, records that `top_p` is unset and therefore provider-governed, and adds drift tests in tests/test_env_template.py that fail when the template and config.toml diverge. No `top_p` config knob was added: 1.0 is a no-op and any lower value would truncate the sampling distribution on a guess, so the audit's original recommendation was deliberately not implemented as a behaviour change.
